title: The Ongoing Fight Against Measles in Bangladesh
subtitle: Despite massive vaccination efforts, a deadly outbreak continues to challenge health authorities.

summary.en: Bangladesh is currently facing a severe measles outbreak that has resulted in over 1,000 deaths since March. Although the government launched a large vaccination campaign, the virus continues to spread rapidly among children. Experts explain that the initial immunization targets were not high enough to protect the entire population. Malnutrition is also making it harder for children to fight off the infection. Health officials are now planning further efforts to close the immunity gap and stop the disease.
summary.zh: 孟加拉目前正面臨嚴重的麻疹疫情，自三月以來已造成超過一千人死亡。儘管政府發起了大規模疫苗接種行動，病毒仍在兒童之間迅速傳播。專家解釋，最初的免疫目標不足以保護全體人口。營養不良也使得兒童更難以對抗感染。衛生官員目前正計畫進一步採取行動，以填補免疫缺口並遏止疾病蔓延。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, the world watched with concern as a measles outbreak began to spread rapidly across Bangladesh. While there was early hope that the situation would soon be under control, the reality has proven to be much more difficult. According to NPR News, the country has faced a devastating situation, with more than 1,000 children losing their lives to the disease since March 15.
paragraphs.zh: 今年稍早，全球密切關注孟加拉（Bangladesh）境內迅速蔓延的麻疹疫情，並對此深感憂心。儘管起初人們希望情況能儘快受到控制，但現實卻遠比預期困難。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR News）報導，該國面臨了毀滅性的處境，自三月十五日以來，已有超過一千名兒童因感染此疾病而喪生。

paragraphs.en: In April, the government launched a major vaccination campaign. The goal was to give 18 million children the measles vaccine—a medicine that protects people from the virus. The effort was successful in terms of numbers, with 18.4 million doses given. However, despite this progress, the virus continues to move quickly through the population. NPR News reports that from January to June of this year, Bangladesh recorded more measles cases than any other country, totaling 57,561 cases.
paragraphs.zh: 四月時，政府發起了一項大型疫苗接種計畫，目標是為一千八百萬名兒童施打麻疹疫苗，這種藥物能保護民眾免受病毒侵害。就數據而言，這項行動相當成功，共施打了一千八百四十萬劑疫苗。然而，儘管有所進展，病毒仍在人口中快速傳播。NPR News 指出，今年一月至六月間，孟加拉記錄到的麻疹病例數高居全球之冠，總計達五萬七千五百六十一例。

paragraphs.en: Why has the virus been so hard to stop? Experts point to a few key reasons. First, the initial vaccination goal was not high enough. Health officials now believe that 22.6 million children needed to be vaccinated to truly stop the spread. This gap in immunization gave the virus a chance to keep moving from person to person. Because measles is highly contagious, even a small number of unvaccinated children can lead to a large outbreak.
paragraphs.zh: 為什麼這種病毒如此難以遏止？專家指出幾個關鍵原因。首先，最初設定的疫苗接種目標並不夠高。衛生官員現在認為，必須為兩千兩百六十萬名兒童接種疫苗，才能真正阻止疫情擴散。這種免疫缺口讓病毒有機會持續在人與人之間傳播。由於麻疹具有高度傳染性，即使只有少數兒童未接種疫苗，也可能引發大規模疫情。

paragraphs.en: NPR News spoke with Tajul Abdul Bari, a vaccine expert, who explained that the country cannot afford to relax its efforts. He suggested that a new campaign is needed, potentially covering children up to 10 years old. Dr. Javid Abdelmoneim of Médecins Sans Frontières International emphasized that the only way to manage such an outbreak is to vaccinate as many people as possible. He noted that because measles is so easily spread, one single case can potentially affect 100 other people.
paragraphs.zh: NPR News 採訪了疫苗專家塔朱爾·阿卜杜勒·巴里（Tajul Abdul Bari），他解釋說該國無法承受鬆懈的代價。他建議需要展開新一輪的接種行動，並將涵蓋範圍擴大至十歲以下的兒童。無國界醫生組織（Médecins Sans Frontières International）的賈維德·阿卜杜勒莫尼姆（Javid Abdelmoneim）醫師強調，應對此類疫情的唯一方法就是盡可能為更多人接種疫苗。他指出，由於麻疹極易傳播，單一病例就可能影響另外一百人。

paragraphs.en: Data from UNICEF, as reported by NPR News, shows that 72% of the people who caught the disease had never received a dose of the two-dose vaccine. Another 16% had only received partial protection. This confirms that the lack of full vaccination is a primary driver of the current crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 根據 NPR News 引述聯合國兒童基金會（UNICEF）的數據顯示，百分之七十二的染病者從未接種過兩劑型疫苗中的任何一劑，另有百分之十六的人僅獲得部分保護。這證實了疫苗接種不完全是導致當前危機的主要原因。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the virus itself, the health of the children plays a major role in how they experience the illness. Many children in the region suffer from malnutrition, which is a condition where a person does not get enough healthy food to grow properly. Colonel Latifa Rahman, director of a hospital in the capital city that is now dedicated to measles care, explained that malnutrition makes the disease much more dangerous. When children are underweight or dealing with other health issues, their bodies struggle to fight the infection. Furthermore, malnutrition can make the vaccine less effective, meaning even those who are vaccinated may have a weaker immune response.
paragraphs.zh: 除了病毒本身，兒童的健康狀況在他們罹病後的反應中扮演重要角色。該地區許多兒童飽受營養不良之苦，這是一種因無法攝取足夠健康食物而導致生長發育受阻的狀況。位於首都、現專門收治麻疹病患的醫院院長拉蒂法·拉赫曼（Latifa Rahman）上校解釋說，營養不良使這種疾病變得更加危險。當兒童體重過輕或有其他健康問題時，他們的身體難以對抗感染。此外，營養不良可能降低疫苗效力，這意味著即使是已接種疫苗的兒童，其免疫反應也可能較弱。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the situation remains serious. On August 31, authorities recorded 1,162 suspected cases and 94 confirmed cases in just 24 hours. To address this, the government has announced plans to vaccinate another 1.6 million children. The path forward requires constant attention to ensure that every child is reached. As experts have noted, every missed child increases the risk for the entire community. The fight against measles in Bangladesh serves as a reminder of how important it is to maintain high levels of vaccination to keep communities safe from preventable diseases.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，局勢依然嚴峻。八月三十一日，當局在短短二十四小時內記錄到一千一百六十二例疑似病例與九十四例確診病例。為了解決此問題，政府已宣布計畫再為一百六十萬名兒童接種疫苗。未來的道路需要持續關注，以確保每一位兒童都能獲得保護。正如專家所言，每一位被遺漏的兒童都會增加整個社區的風險。孟加拉對抗麻疹的戰役提醒了我們，維持高水準的疫苗接種率對於保護社區免受可預防疾病的侵害至關重要。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A difference or lack of something that prevents a goal from being reached.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 差距、缺口（指未達標的不足之處）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指物理上的縫隙，這裡指疫苗接種數量不足的缺口。文中：This gap in immunization gave the virus a chance to keep moving from person to person.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A main cause or force that makes something happen.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指開車的人，這裡指導致危機的主要因素。文中：This confirms that the lack of full vaccination is a primary driver of the current crisis.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To deal with or take action to solve a problem.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指地址或演講，這裡指採取行動解決問題。文中：To address this, the government has announced plans to vaccinate another 1.6 million children.

sources.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?

quiz.question: According to the article, what was the specific reason health officials cited for the failure to stop the measles outbreak despite the vaccination campaign?

options.A: The vaccine provided was not effective against the specific strain of the virus.
options.B: The initial target number for vaccinations was set too low to achieve herd immunity.
options.C: The government failed to distribute the 18 million doses they had planned.
options.D: The population refused to participate in the vaccination campaign due to fear.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，專家指出疫苗接種目標設定過低（1800萬劑不足以阻止病毒傳播，實際需要2260萬劑），這導致病毒仍有機會在未接種的兒童間擴散。選項 A 文章未提及疫苗無效；選項 C 與文章內容矛盾，因為政府確實完成了 1840 萬劑的施打；選項 D 文章並未提到民眾拒絕接種，而是強調接種覆蓋率不足。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the relationship between malnutrition and measles in Bangladesh?

options.A: Malnutrition is the primary cause of the measles virus mutation.
options.B: Children with malnutrition are more likely to experience severe symptoms and have a weaker response to vaccines.
options.C: Malnutrition is only a concern for children who have already been diagnosed with measles.
options.D: The government is prioritizing nutritional programs over vaccination campaigns to fight the disease.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第六段，醫院院長指出營養不良會使疾病變得更危險，且身體較難抵抗感染，甚至會降低疫苗的有效性。選項 A 文章並未指出營養不良會導致病毒變異；選項 C 錯誤，營養不良是普遍的健康問題，非僅限於確診者；選項 D 文章中並未提到政府將營養計畫置於疫苗接種之上，兩者並無此優先級的比較。

quiz.question: In the context of the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'driver' mean?

options.A: A person who operates a vehicle.
options.B: A primary cause or factor that pushes a situation forward.
options.C: A technological tool used to improve health data.
options.D: A person who leads a medical team.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此文中，'driver' 被用來形容導致危機的主要因素或動力（a primary driver of the current crisis）。選項 A 是字面意思，但在文中不適用；選項 C 與 D 均為對該詞語在醫學或日常語境下的錯誤解讀，並未反映出「推動因素」的隱喻用法。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the measles situation in Bangladesh?

options.A: The measles outbreak has been successfully contained thanks to government intervention.
options.B: Vaccination is unnecessary if the population is well-nourished.
options.C: The crisis highlights the ongoing struggle to achieve high immunization coverage and the complicating role of malnutrition.
options.D: International organizations have abandoned their efforts to help Bangladesh manage the outbreak.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體論述了孟加拉麻疹疫情的嚴重性，並強調了疫苗接種覆蓋率不足以及營養不良如何加劇危機，總結了目前防疫面臨的挑戰。選項 A 與事實不符，疫情仍在持續；選項 B 錯誤，疫苗接種是防疫核心，營養僅是輔助因素；選項 D 與事實相反，文中提到如無國界醫生等組織仍在積極參與防疫。
